Services

Services

Four services that build on each other. Each can be commissioned on its own — together they make a website that is designed, built, found and maintained.

  1. 01

    Web Design

    Custom, conversion-driven design — no template, no site builder.

    • Structure & site plan
    • Clickable draft
    • Design system
    • Copy scaffold
    Pricing
    from €2,900 per project
    Process
    1–2 weeks to an approved draft

    Learn more

  2. 02

    Web Development

    Hand-written code instead of a plugin stack — fast, maintainable, no legacy.

    • Statically generated site
    • A CMS you maintain yourself
    • Bilingual by construction
    • Forms & integrations
    Pricing
    included in the project price
    Process
    2–4 weeks

    Learn more

  3. 03

    SEO & Performance

    Get found and be fast — technically evidenced, not promised.

    • Technical foundation
    • Core Web Vitals
    • Structured data
    • Keyword and page structure
    Pricing
    base setup included · ongoing from €190/month
    Process
    Setup within the project · effect after 3–6 months

    Learn more

  4. 04

    Care & Support

    Updates, security, backups and one person to call — cancel monthly.

    • Updates & dependencies
    • Security & monitoring
    • Backups
    • Uptime checks
    Pricing
    from €49/month
    Process
    ongoing, cancel monthly

    Learn more

How the four fit together

In most projects design and development run as one commission, SEO comes along as a base setup, and care starts at launch. You can also book a single service — an audit of your existing site, for instance, or taking over maintenance.
